title: henckelia cinerea
intro: Henckelia cinerea, commonly known as the Himalayan Balsam, is a flowering plant native to the Himalayan region. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Henckelia cinerea include acting as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
